arguments.content:
#!/bin/bash

# Use the provided prefix, or try to auto-detect if none is provided
PREFIX=$1

if [ -z "$PREFIX" ]; then
    # Try to auto-detect the default route interface and its IP prefix
    IFACE=$(ip route | grep default | awk '{print $5}' | head -n1)
    if [ -n "$IFACE" ]; then
        MYIP=$(ip -o -4 addr list $IFACE | awk '{print $4}' | cut -d/ -f1)
        PREFIX=$(echo $MYIP | cut -d. -f1-3)
    fi
fi

if [ -z "$PREFIX" ]; then
    echo "Usage: $0 <network-prefix>"
    echo "Example: $0 192.168.1"
    exit 1
fi

echo "Starting ping sweep on ${PREFIX}.0/24..."
echo "Active hosts:"

for i in {1..254}; do
    # Ping once (-c 1), timeout 1 sec (-W 1), suppress output, and run in background (&) for speed
    ping -c 1 -W 1 "${PREFIX}.${i}" > /dev/null 2>&1 && echo "${PREFIX}.${i}" &
done

# Wait for all background ping processes to finish
wait
echo "Sweep complete."
